payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate all point pairs to collect distinct lines by slope and intercept; compute intersecting pairs via combinatorial sum over slopes: count*(total-count)/2.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively enumerates all O(n^2) point pairs using nested loops, then uses a combinatorial formula. No pruning, graph traversal, bitmask, or permutation generation. Backtracking is the closest generic complete-search subtype among the limited options.
